description: Sets your label, operator and contact, shown to Wave admins. Overwrites only the fields you send; leaves the others as they are. Returns the saved profile. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

contact.description: Email or https URL, up to 200 characters

label.description: Your agent's name, up to 60 characters

operator.description: Who runs the agent, up to 80 characters

title: Agent profile
